subject: Q3 Close — final-pass account triage and finance-ready actions
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@altavista.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Close — final-pass account triage and finance-ready actions

Team,

We're on the final pass for Q3 and need to lock any outstanding commits that finance can recognize by Monday close. Quick ask: please update the attached commit_matrix.csv with the fields below by EOD today (29 Jul). I'll run a 10:30 standup tomorrow to triage anything flagged as 'finance: verify'.

Required columns to update (add a short note if anything is soft):
- committed_amount (USD)
- PO_received (yes/no)
- revenue_cert (attached / pending / not required)
- close_confidence (%)
- close_date_target

Priority accounts: Altavista Media (RDW-2741) — Samira is on copy — and three others in the matrix. Ben, please highlight any discounts or credits that need approval. David, mark anything that requires revenue deferral conversation.

Attachments: [Attachment: commit_matrix.csv (CSV)]

Next steps:
- Today: update matrix (owner-owned rows only)
- Tomorrow 10:30am PT: 20-minute triage (calendar invite to follow)
- If PO is delayed past Tue close, list expected ETA + procurement contact

Thanks — short and surgical.

-Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Global Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@altavista.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close — final-pass account triage and finance-ready actions

Stephanie / team,

I've started a quick pass on the matrix. A couple of finance items for Altavista and two other accounts:

- Altavista (RDW-2741): revenue_cert needs to be signed — asking for the formal revenue confirmation doc, not just PO. If they can provide the revenue-cert.pdf (signed) we can recognize in July otherwise we'll need to consider deferral to Aug.
- For deals with split billing (monthly + one-time), include the invoice schedule in the matrix so I can map to recognition buckets.
- If any deals have pending legal redlines around SOW/value thresholds, flag as 'legal review' — those cannot be recognized until closed.

I attached a short template I used last quarter to confirm revenue evidence: [Attachment: revenue-cert.pdf (PDF)].

I'll be on the 10:30 triage. If anyone needs a break-out with finance, ping me before 10:00 and I'll open a quick call.

-David
David Kim
Head of Finance, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira@altavista.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close — final-pass account triage and finance-ready actions

All — updated my book in the attached matrix. Highlights for the triage:

- Altavista Media (RDW-2741):
  - Committed amount: $195,000
  - PO_received: no (procurement says PO in process)
  - revenue_cert: pending (Samira, can you confirm if procurement will sign the revenue confirmation or if legal prefers PO-only?)
  - close_confidence: 85% (sales execs aligned, contracting working through standard SOW)
  - close_date_target: 2027-07-30
  - Note: Sales offered a small implementation credit ($5k) to accelerate signature; no change to MRR.

- Two mid-tier accounts flagged for special handling — both have POs but one has a billing term change (net 60) — David, that will affect recognition timing if we accept net 60.

Requests for triage:
- David: confirm whether a signed PO alone is acceptable for July recognition for standard SaaS ARR (we should be consistent).
- Ben: confirm discount approval trail for Altavista credit so finance has backup.

Samira — any update from procurement on PO ETA would be helpful. We can accept a DocuSign link or a scanned PO that lists billing terms.

Forwarding portion of David's note below for context.

On Thu, Jul 29, 2027 at 11:04 AM David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Samira Khan <samira@altavista.com>

Cc: procure@altavista.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close — final-pass account triage and finance-ready actions

Hi all,

Thanks for the note — procurement is finalizing the PO and we expect DocuSign to route today. I confirmed with our legal/procurement team that they can provide a signed PO (PO_Altavista_2758.pdf) and a revenue confirmation statement; I'll forward both as soon as they're available.

Quick answers to Marissa's asks:
- PO ETA: EOD today (30 Jul) — DocuSign link will be provided
- Revenue confirmation: procurement indicated they can sign a revenue confirmation PDF; they prefer the template you attached (revenue-cert.pdf).
- Billing terms: standard net 30 — no net 60 changes.

If anything slips, I'll escalate internally and loop back to you by 2pm PT.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Procurement
Altavista Media
